modelId.description:
The {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel#id} that we are validating can be retrained with the current state of the
[faulty sensors](Sensor#operationalStatus).

impactedRelationIds.description:
The list of {@link ReliabilityAssetToRiskModelRelation#id}s that have been identified as being impacted by the
most recent changes to the [faulty sensors](Sensor#operationalStatus).

All IDs in this list should have a matching entry in the `allRelations` field.

allRelations.description:
All the relations associated with the {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel} that has the `modelId`. We will validate
which of these relations are valid to retrain.

sourceOfTruthModel.description:
The [source of truth](FaultySensor.RiskModelSourceOfTruthRelation) model for #modelId. This model defines the
{@link Feature.Set}s that need to be validated to ensure that the model can be retrained.

title:
The input spec to the function {@link FaultySensor.ModelImpactMapReduceJob#validateModelCanBeRetrained}.

See that type for more information.
name: FaultySensor.ModelRetrainValidationInput
